verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents composing emails in a drag-and-drop editor, segmentation for audiences, campaign creation via API, and an AI Composer that builds the audience and drafts content. None of the evidence explicitly documents sending a campaign immediately or scheduling it for a set time; 'map out the send strategy' is planning, not dispatch. missing for 10: explicit documentation of send-now and scheduled-send for campaigns, documented audience selection within the campaign flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: use the drag-and-drop email/SMS editors and build automations, segmentation and reports
Creates a campaign given a set of parameters, then returns it.
Tell Composer what you're trying to achieve, and it'll build the audience, draft the content, and map out the send strategy.
Your MCP client can help with a variety of tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports.
